verdict.rationale: For a datacenter accelerator, headless automated operation is the normal mode. AMD documents its own tooling for it: the AMD SMI user-space management tool, the AMD Container Toolkit for Docker, a Kubernetes GPU Operator and Device Plugin, the Slurm-compatible Spur job scheduler, and scriptable validation suites (ROCm Validation Suite, Cluster Validation Suite test scripts). missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration docs or examples, in-depth (beyond one-line) documentation of non-interactive/scripted usage, independent hands-on corroboration of automated runs.
